heading: Spain vs Argentina Final Highlights - Spain wins FIFA World Cup 2026; Torres scores winner; Messi and Co. lose
author: Team Sportstar
paragraphs: Rodri lifts the FIFA World Cup trophy after Spain beat defending champion Argentina to win its second World Cup title. | Photo Credit: AP

Welcome to Sportstar’s live coverage of the FIFA World Cup 2026 final, Spain vs Argentina, being played at the New York New Jersey Stadium in East Rutherford. Lionel Messi leads Argentina’s attack, while Spain has Lamine Yamal among its attacking options.
106’ Goal! | Nico Williams got a cross from the left, who stretched the defence and then sent in a cross to Ferran Torres who beat Emiliano Martinez to score.
5’ Chance! Lamine Yamal got the ball along the right flank and he tried to shoot on target. He was intercepted, not once, but twice.
43’ Chance! Fabian Ruiz passed to Marc Cucurella, who marched up the pitch and took a shot from outside the box, which went wide!
67’ Chance for Spain! Yamal kept the ball to his feet and crossed from the right. Torres rose to get a head to it and kept his attempt on target. Emi Martinez made a good save.
Spain (4-3-3): Unai Simón; Pedro Porro, Aymeric Laporte, Pau Cubarsí, Marc Cucurella; Rodri, Fabián Ruiz, Dani Olmo; Lamine Yamal, Álex Baena, Mikel Oyarzabal.

Argentina (4-4-2): Emiliano Martínez; Gonzalo Montiel, Cristian Romero, Lisandro Martínez, Nicolás Tagliafico; Nico Gonzalez, Alexis Mac Allister, Rodrigo de Paul, Enzo Fernández; Lionel Messi, Julián Álvarez.
Venue: MetLife Stadium (New York-New Jersey Stadium), East Rutherford, NJ
Kick-off time: 3:00 pm local time, July 19 (12:30 am, July 20)
